title: Pli
description: A paper-folding puzzle. Fold an inky sheet along any line: stains that meet merge into one, while grains of sand refuse to overlap and block careless folds. Keep folding until a single vermillion stain rests exactly on the target. 12 handcrafted sheets, each with a proven optimal fold count, from a two-cell warm-up to six-fold workshops. Ink-and-paper palette, touch-first, in English, French and Spanish.
controls: Tap a dashed fold line between two columns or rows, then tap an arrow to fold that side over — or use the arrow keys to fold through the middle.
The folding side must be no wider than the side that stays in place.
U to undo, R to restart the sheet. Ink merges; overlapping grains or grain-and-ink refuse the fold.
credits: A game by Cédric Bernadac, created with AI agents (ZCode & Kimi K3.1 Pro).
